title: A Game of Thrones
author: George R. R. Martin
summary: When the king asks his old friend Ned Stark to serve as his chief adviser, a northern lord is pulled to the capital. Elsewhere, an exiled princess is married off across the sea, and something stirs beyond the great Wall of ice.
readIf: you want a sprawling, unpredictable, politically sharp fantasy where nobody is safe.
skipIf: you want hope, tidy heroes or to avoid graphic violence and harsh treatment of women and children.

pairings.reason: A grimmer, wittier fantasy with morally compromised characters and bloody politics.
Another large-scale epic with many viewpoints, but more optimistic and led by women.
The classic that this series reacts against, with a more straightforward moral world.
